prompt_en: Create a photorealistic cinematic environmental photograph of a spring-wound Clockpunk eclipse rehearsal inside a midnight civic time tower. An unmistakably adult woman, whose broad appearance cues are guided only by the supplied portrait, is the sole human subject, with long near-black wavy hair, warm brown eyes, softly arched brows, an oval face, and natural rose lips. In a charcoal horologist’s coat threaded with fine watch chains, she turns an oversized brass winding key inside a glass-cased astronomical clock; show her fingers naturally wrapped around the key, its shaft visibly inserted, with a crisp contact shadow. The key action visibly releases a palm-sized enamel mechanical bird halfway from an opened escapement cage while a coiled mainspring unspools and a recognizable escapement moves through intermeshing brass gears. Concentric numbered time dials and a distinct moon-phase disk click into eclipse. Use a three-quarter environmental frame that keeps her face, hand-to-key contact, bird, and large clock mechanism simultaneously legible. Behind her, a wall-sized connected gear train, suspended pocket watches, and horological calibration tools define the working tower. Let cool moonlight through high windows and warm clock-lamp reflections share the same brass, glass, skin, and fabric surfaces, with shallow depth and restrained motion blur on the moving gear train.
